page.layout: One printed page, title page. Top: page number 401 centred above the title. Centre: title block in capitals and italic lines, then a woodcut emblem with a banner reading "NULLA EST VIA INVIA" (partly visible: "EST VIA", "INVIA", "NVLLA"... ) with a rule below and the date at the foot. No columns, no margin notes.
page.notes: Woodcut emblem between the title block and the date: an oval banner with the inscription around the rim, partly legible ("EST VIA", "INVIA", "NVLLA", "VIRTVTI"), showing a figure with a tree and an eagle. The long s is printed as s throughout. Title lines are set in mixed capitals and italic; the "KECKER-MANNO" line is hyphenated across lines as printed.
